reviewer: Claude (agent). Judged from contact sheets, seam strips, frame snapshots and measured QA. The film was not auditioned by ear and not watched end-to-end at real speed.

criteria.question: One clear focal point per beat; reading order is obvious.
criteria.notes: One dominant element per beat: the 13,200 counter on the vermilion sheet (s3), the paper '6' (s4), the dome and skyline (s5). s1 carries five small elements (moon, tape, note, stamp, flame) before the banner lands; the eye has to be led by the narration timing.

criteria.question: Type roles are consistent; sizes respect the floor; no orphans or awkward breaks.
criteria.notes: Three faces used with clear roles (Archivo Black display, Nunito text, Space Mono dates/lines); QA found no text below the 2.6% floor. 'estimated 13,200 to 13,500' is the smallest line and is easy to miss, though it carries the uncertainty.

criteria.question: Layouts are intentional in every format (not stretched or cropped landscape).
criteria.notes: Landscape only (the brief asked for one format). s3 and s5 use the frame well; s4 is deliberately sparse (declared intent: minimal). The upper-left of s5 is empty apart from one small note.

criteria.question: Holds match reading time; rhythm varies; nothing drags or rushes.
criteria.notes: Visual events every 0.6-2.0 s during narration; longest unchanged stretch 1.8 s (QA note). s4 opens with ~0.65 s of an empty sheet during the crossfade, which is intentional. Not yet watched with sound at real speed.

criteria.question: All text is legible at delivery size with sufficient contrast.
criteria.notes: All text above the size floor; high-contrast ink on paper and cream on vermilion by inspection. Contrast over image textures is not measured by the tool (it declines to estimate), so this rests on eyes, not numbers.

criteria.question: Palette and texture follow the chosen style system and direction.
criteria.notes: Follows paper-cut: kraft ground, vermilion, marigold, slate blue, charcoal. Procedural paper textures read as paper; SVG cut-outs carry hard shadows. The flat vector buildings are cleaner than the textured sheets, so the two layers are not fully the same material.

criteria.question: Each transition carries meaning or continuity; none are decorative filler.
criteria.notes: Four different, motivated seams: push (time moves on), torn-edge wipe with a vermilion edge, a calm crossfade into the quiet beat, and a match-cut where the '6' disc becomes the dome head. Verified on seams.jpg. The crossfade is the plainest.

criteria.question: Motion vocabulary is consistent across scenes.
criteria.notes: Placed-paper vocabulary throughout: slides, stamps, tape, pop. Charring is a consistent fill-to-ink device (houses, churches, dome, map blob).

criteria.question: No repetitive looping filler or motion without purpose.
criteria.notes: Flame flicker and slow drift are the only continuous motions and both mean something (fire; camera). No looping decoration.

criteria.question: No unintended static stretches; intentional holds are marked.
criteria.notes: Zero measured warnings after fixes; the s5 hold of 3 s found by QA was replaced by a scaffolding event. s4's two static stretches are declared intent: minimal and reported as waivers, not passes.

criteria.question: No accidental overlaps, clipping or safe-area violations.
criteria.notes: Text-collision and clipping checks clean on the final composition; five overlaps found and fixed earlier by eye and by the tool (stamp over tape, clipped banner, tape and RUIN stamp at the frame edge, smoke over tickets, line into the '6' circle).

criteria.question: Clear opening, progression and ending; the last frame holds long enough.
criteria.notes: Clear problem, mechanism, consequence, honest doubt, resolution; ends smaller and quieter (title tape last, end hold 1.33 s). The uncertain death toll is given its own beat instead of a single number.

verdict: Scores are an agent's critique, not user acceptance. The rubric's pass rule is met on paper; the highest-value remaining check is a human watching it with sound.
pass_rule: Every criterion scored 1-5 with evidence (frame or contact-sheet paths); all >= 3 and mean >= 3.5.
